dedupe_keys.name: proprete reseau de chauffage urbain grand poitiers donnees metiers

description: Propreté - Réseau de chauffage urbain - Grand Poitiers Données métiers is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by sig.grandpoitiers.fr. The Ville de Poitiers heat network supplies heat (heating) and sanitary hot water 7500 equivalent housing units on the Cororries and Saint Eloi, from an energy mix composed of the 3 different heat sources (UVE, Biomass, Gas). Coverage: the city of Poitiers. The portal shows the English title as "Cleanliness — District heating network — Grand Poitiers Business data" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include valorisation énergétique, chauffage, biomasse, données ouvertes, chauffage urbain, réseau de chauffage urbain. The listing shows 3 download or service links in WFS, WMS. The listing shows 2015-11-05 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
